changeSet.author: PuneetGupta
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[ResponsibilityDetailByAssetTypeID] ( @AssetTypeID int ) RETURNS TABLE with Schemabinding AS RETURN ( With AssetRule as ( select a.AssetTypeID AssetTypeID, rasset.AssetID, rasset.RuleID from [dbo].[asset] a inner join [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] rasset on (rasset.AssetID = a.ID) where a.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID union all select rasset.AssetTypeID, rasset.AssetID, rasset.RuleID from [dbo].[ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] rasset where (rasset.AssetID = 0 and rasset.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID) ) select r.id as RuleID, r.ResponsibilityTypeID as ResponsibilityTypeID, RT.Name as ResponsibilityTypeName, rasset.AssetID, rasset.AssetTypeID, rresource.SecurityAssetID as ResourceID, RES.FirstName + ' ' + RES.LastName as ResourceName, rresource.SecurityAsset, rresource.SecurityAssetID, RES.FirstName + ' ' + RES.LastName as SecurityAssetName, r.Context, r.ApplyToType, r.IsVisible, NULL as OverrideID, RES.uid as ResourceUid, RES.uid as SecurityAssetUid from AssetRule rasset inner join dbo.responsibilitytyperelationrule r on (r.ID = rasset.RuleID) inner join dbo.[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource on (r.ID = rresource.RuleID) inner join dbo.ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = r.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = rresource.SecurityAssetID and rresource.SecurityAsset = 'R' where RES.State=1 union all select r.id as RuleID, r.ResponsibilityTypeID as ResponsibilityTypeID, RT.Name as ResponsibilityTypeName, rasset.AssetID, rasset.AssetTypeID, RG.ResourceID as ResourceID, RES.FirstName + ' ' + RES.LastName as ResourceName, rresource.SecurityAsset, rresource.SecurityAssetID, G.Name as SecurityAssetName, r.Context, r.ApplyToType, r.IsVisible, NULL as OverrideID, RES.uid as ResourceUid, secasset.uid as SecurityAssetUid from AssetRule rasset inner join dbo.responsibilitytyperelationrule r on (r.ID = rasset.RuleID) inner join dbo.[ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource on (r.ID = rresource.RuleID) inner join dbo.ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = r.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join dbo.[Group] G on rresource.SecurityAsset = 'G' and G.ID = rresource.SecurityAssetID inner join dbo.[Asset] secasset ON secasset.[Object] = 'Group' AND secasset.ObjectID = rresource.SecurityAssetID inner join dbo.ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = RG.ResourceID where RES.State=1 union all select 0 as RuleID, oride.ResponsibilityTypeID as ResponsibilityTypeID, RT.Name as ResponsibilityTypeName, oride.AssetID, a.AssetTypeID as AssetTypeID, RES.ResourceID as ResourceID, RES.FirstName + ' ' + RES.LastName as ResourceName, oride.SecurityAsset, oride.SecurityAssetID, RES.FirstName + ' ' + RES.LastName as SecurityAssetName, oride.Context, cast(0 as bit) as ApplyToType, cast(1 as bit) as IsVisible, oride.ID as OverrideID, RES.uid as ResourceUid, RES.uid as SecurityAssetUid from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] oride inner join dbo.ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join [dbo].asset a on (a.id = oride.assetID and a.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID) inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = oride.SecurityAssetID and oride.SecurityAsset = 'R' and RES.State = 1 union all select 0 as RuleID, oride.ResponsibilityTypeID as ResponsibilityTypeID, RT.Name as ResponsibilityTypeName, oride.AssetID, a.AssetTypeID as AssetTypeID, RES.ResourceID as ResourceID, RES.FirstName + ' ' + RES.LastName as ResourceName, oride.SecurityAsset, oride.SecurityAssetID, G.[Name] as SecurityAssetName, oride.Context, cast(0 as bit) as ApplyToType, cast(1 as bit) as IsVisible, oride.ID as OverrideID, RES.uid as ResourceUid, secasset.uid as SecurityAssetUid from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] oride inner join dbo.ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join [dbo].asset a on (a.id = oride.assetID and a.AssetTypeID = @AssetTypeID) inner join dbo.[Group] G on oride.SecurityAsset = 'G' and G.ID = oride.SecurityAssetID inner join dbo.[Asset] secasset ON secasset.[Object] = 'Group' AND secasset.ObjectID = oride.SecurityAssetID inner join dbo.ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = RG.ResourceID and RES.[State] = 1 )
